input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11 addresses term, breach termination and survival (including continued use rights and Commerce One's continuing support obligation), but contains no post-termination transition assistance or data return/deletion mechanic; a search of the agreement returns no transition, exit, migration, data export or data-return language, and Section 12 only covers source code escrow on defined Release Conditions. As the customer/ASP whose Customers' data flows through Commerce One's MarketSite.net Service, we need a defined exit path. Inserted a new Section 11.4 matching the preferred position: up to six (6) months of transition assistance at Commerce One's then-current rates, return of our and our Customers' data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and certified deletion thereafter, expressly overriding the generic return-or-destroy sentence in Section 11.3.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 11.4 requiring Commerce One to provide up to six months of transition assistance and to return, then certify deletion of, Corio and Customer data.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11 covers survival but gives us no exit path, so we have added a transition-assistance and data-return provision: up to six (6) months of assistance at Commerce One's then-current rates, return of our and our Customers' data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is an issue we can live with ninety (90) days of assistance, but we need the data return and deletion certificate.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Notwithstanding Section 11.3, upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall, at Corio's request: (a) provide reasonable transition assistance, including continued access to the Software, the MarketSite.net Service and related support, as reasonably necessary for Corio to continue supporting its then-existing Customers and Software Users or to migrate them to an alternative solution, for a period of up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return or deliver to Corio all data of Corio, its Customers and Software Users then in Commerce One's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.
